title: Toxicity in Online Platforms and AI Systems: A Survey of Needs, Challenges, Mitigations, and Future Directions
base_benchmarks: BOLD (Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation Dataset)
findings: The survey finds that religion is a significant category where biases manifest in Large Language Models and online platforms. It cites research indicating that substantial biases are found in categories related to race, followed by gender, health, and religion. Furthermore, several key datasets designed for toxicity and bias detection (e.g., RedditBias, HSBERT) explicitly include religion as a primary dimension for analysis.
